XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Phase sensor

  • Fault: Occasional failure to start the engine. Once the vehicle has started, it runs normally.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: On injection control unit: P1320 (Phase and RPM signal consistency - Fault)

  • Cause: Faulty phase sensor

• Action: Check that the phase sensor is working correctly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side, on the valve cover behind the camshaft pulley.
    It is not necessary to remove the timing belt to remove the sensor.

    The estimated time for the job is approximately 0.4 hours.
